_README: Bubblewrap config for the Android Trusted Web Activity. Filled in for the GitHub Pages project site https://gitlgn.github.io/SimAquarium/. Run `bubblewrap init --manifest https://gitlgn.github.io/SimAquarium/manifest.webmanifest` after the site is live. Do NOT commit the generated keystore. See docs/ANDROID.md.
_WARNING_ASSET_LINKS: Android verifies Digital Asset Links at the ORIGIN ROOT: https://gitlgn.github.io/.well-known/assetlinks.json — NOT the /SimAquarium/ subpath. This repo cannot publish a file there. Until it can (a gitlgn.github.io user-pages repo, or a custom domain), the TWA does not verify and Chrome keeps the URL bar visible. For a barless install on the S25, use Chrome's 'Install app' on the PWA instead (docs/ANDROID.md §0).
